Casner Creek's W/E sites (centroid 37.6582,-96.1004, ~340 m NW) sit 50-100 m back from the north shore behind trees, with its primitive pads 116-123 at the shoreline. Stored pin (37.6566,-96.0973) is in the Fredonia Bay row, ~50 m from its centroid.

min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

values.note: Reserved site-specific on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov). 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground; a 14-day extension needs the park manager's written permission, and a five-day absence is required before camping again. The park is run from the Cross Timbers office: only gatehouse and maintenance staff are on site. Casner Creek 104, 106, 108-111, 113 and Fredonia Bay 020 and 030 are long-term sites.

Scope: KDWP's 'Fredonia Bay' area (44 W/E + 1 full hookup) covers both the Fredonia Bay row and Casner Creek (~340 m NW on the same park road), so this entry counts both, plus Gobbler's Knob 301. Not a split (one entrance, one permit station).

Waterfront kept lakeview: Fredonia Bay's north-end sites are 30-60 m from the bay behind the loop road and trees, Casner Creek's W/E sites 50-100 m back behind trees (booking site 'River/Lake View: Y'); only primitive 15-ft pads (116-123) are at the shore.

Catalog quirks: Fredonia Bay 030 is typed full hookup with 'Number of Utilities: 3' but 'Sewer Hookup' blank; Gobbler's Knob 301 is typed full hookup with sewer but 'Water Hookup' blank. Counted both as full hookups (KDWP says one).
Long-stay share (informational): 9 of 46 utility sites are typed long-term.
Dump station not confirmed: only the boilerplate grey-water rule mentions one; left unset.
Pin fine; phone 620-637-2213 confirmed (KDWP 'Park Office', campitks 'Project Office'). No sand-rule issue (gravel pads on a park road).
